per_candidate.id: s2:A Census of the β Pic Moving Group and Other Nearby Associations with Gaia

rationale: The papers 2503.02084, 2311.17996, and 2405.05314 investigate dynamics and instabilities in protoplanetary disks, contributing evidence relevant to the question about the dynamics of protoplanetary disks and their relation to dust ring axisymmetry and emission line profiles.
